description: This source file implements the functions for managing a Sys Rro Bool Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization, within a larger system environment. It defines and sets up the object’s properties, methods, and lifecycle functions, particularly focusing on object-oriented designs simulated in C.

classes.name: SYS_RRO_BOOL_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the object encapsulating a Boolean record in the Sys Rro system, containing properties and methods for creating, removing, and managing the boolean record.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRroBoolCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new Sys Rro Bool Object, setting its basic properties and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRroBoolRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the Sys Rro Bool Object, releasing resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRroBoolEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls any subordinate objects necessary for the Sys Rro Bool Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRroBoolInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the Sys Rro Bool Object, setting its specific fields such as type, size, and value.
